headline: Bangladesh garment workers win 36 percent wage increase following violent protests
label: NEWS
caption:
Garment workers in Bangladesh secured a 36 percent minimum wage increase on Wednesday after weeks of protests, according to officials.

The wage board chairman announced that the majority supported a new minimum wage of 17,000 taka following early Wednesday votes.

Labour representatives noted that while they are not completely satisfied, the revised wage comes after three years instead of the usual five.

Protests and clashes with police previously caused hundreds of millions of dollars in business losses and order shifts to other countries, according to industry groups.
